title: Suitable Method for Routine Diagnostics of EER in Children With Otitis Media With Effusion
brief_summary: The aim of the study was detection of pepsin in effusion in children with OME using Peptest as new quick and cheap method of detection and comparison results with results of other studies in which pepsin was detected by more demanding methods. Such a type of study hasn't been done so far.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* signing of the informed consent
* children at the age between 1 to 7 years diagnosed with bilateral or unilateral OME

Exclusion Criteria:

* children with craniofacial abnormities (Down syndrome, Treacher Collins syndrome, clefts etc.)
